competition.flat_book_pnl: A flat seat has zero net financing/competition P&L: paper NAV earning SOFR is benchmarked at SOFR, so those flows cancel, and shocked-risk financing is zero.
competition.funding_basis: Official NY Fed SOFR ACT/360 is the zero-return competition benchmark, not free alpha. Every seat has $100m paper NAV that may be described as earning SOFR, but that capital is equally funded/benchmarked at SOFR so those flows cancel. Deployed shocked-risk capital pays the same official SOFR on trusted standard-shock risk capital: the absolute MTM loss from a 1% adverse spot move, a 100bp (1 percentage point) adverse outright rate move, or a 100bp adverse curve/RV spread move under the trusted duration-1 P&L convention. Equal risk capital receives equal financing treatment across asset classes. Notional is descriptive, not the funding base. A completely flat book — including no-trade-skeptic — therefore has zero net financing/competition P&L from SOFR cash or funding economics. Positive financing/carry alpha requires an explicit markable strategy that earns above SOFR or funds below SOFR. Weekends and holidays carry the last applicable published fixing until the next fixing. If official fixing history cannot be established, new funding accrual fails closed and prior canonical balances are preserved.
competition.instruction: Do not optimize for gross notional or fill available capacity. Size risk from plausible adverse paths and historical excursions while staying inside the trusted risk-capital and drawdown limits. Flat cash at SOFR is the zero benchmark, not a source of alpha. The no-trade-skeptic must include a structured funding_view on every new risk or NO_TRADE thesis: the frozen official SOFR fixing, the relevant SR3 forward-curve view, its own assessment of whether realized funding will print higher, lower, or about the same as the curve, and the implication for remaining at the zero SOFR benchmark versus paying SOFR on shocked-risk capital.
competition.objective: Finish with the highest cumulative net paper P&L across the 14 standing seats.

research_supplement.summary: Talks with Iran stalled and the White House rejected a peace proposal, so the weekend tape is risk-off again rather than a reopening of Hormuz. Frozen marks still have Brent at 104.32 and WTI at 92.41; those are the book levels, not a later spike print. USDCAD is 1.4143 and two-year yields still give the dollar about 148 basis points over Canada. March 2027 CORRA at 3.145 continues to price roughly 85 basis points of tightening versus 2.30 cash. Australia's June 2027 AONIA is 4.98 against 4.35 cash after another firm labor print, while Japan's currency official warned against yen weakness with the dollar-yen at 157.59 and the 1.25 percent call-rate target now in force. Europe's 10-year is 3.64, and higher yields are already questioning the equity rally. Watch whether Hormuz diplomacy stays dead, whether Canadian implieds keep backing up with oil, and whether the yen warning sticks. The United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the euro area, and Japan are all open for new risk.

carry-is-king.invalidation: The flatten is wrong if oil reverses hard and March implieds resume cheapening through 3.10 without a Canadian policy-path catalyst, showing the oil backup was noise rather than a threat to the remaining carry.

Cash still sits at 2.30 against a 3.145 implied, so about 85 basis points of tightening remain in the contract, but oil is no longer a quiet backdrop and the receive is already crowded. The mark has come 25 basis points from the 3.40 entry; locking that and stepping aside is cleaner than sitting in a commodity-sensitive Canadian path that can gap higher.

Realized overnight funding near 3.88 is consistent with the official fixing, and the SR3 strip already prices a higher future path. New shocked-risk capital would pay SOFR for a view that is already in the curve. Flat cash is not alpha; it is the residual when no trade clears.

no-trade-skeptic.thesis: Hold a flat book. The live ideas are already in the price or already owned. Receive-CORRA is crowded, March implieds at 3.145 still price about 85 basis points of Canadian tightening, and Australian June implieds are already 4.98 against cash 4.35. Official SOFR is 3.88 while the SOFR strip prices 4.38, 4.67 and 4.895; that is a priced funding path, not an unused edge.

deployment_hurdle.benchmark: Official NY Fed SOFR ACT/360 3.88% effective 2026-09-24 is the zero-alpha benchmark.
deployment_hurdle.chosen_action_rationale: The accepted fourteen-seat handoff has no expanding tickets, only holds and one carry flatten, so there are zero independent markable deployment candidates this cycle. Other desks' existing books must not be converted into new risk. Country-specific gaps were not used as a global veto. The prior book is already flat, so staying out is the preservation-consistent action versus official SOFR charged on shocked-risk capital.

grinder.invalidation: Stay-flat is invalidated only if a later frozen cycle presents an independently markable Canada, Australia, euro-area or Japan expanding ticket whose expected edge after plausible adverse P&L clears official SOFR charged on shocked-risk capital. Crowded receive-CORRA and a carry flatten would not, by themselves, create an eligible new line.
grinder.thesis: The book stays flat. The accepted fourteen-seat handoff offers no expanding tickets that would create new risk, so there is no independent markable opportunity against which official SOFR can be charged on shocked-risk capital. Sitting out is the correct action when other desks are managing existing Canada, Australia and US lines rather than offering new ones.

alerts: Crowded Canadian receive with Brent at 104.32 and no markable hedge ticket: watch the March implied through 3.20 with follow-through as the flatten trigger.
pragmatist.invalidation: The view breaks if oil-driven or data-driven hawkish repricing lifts the March contract through 3.20 with follow-through, confirming the tightening path rather than an overpriced stack. With no expanding hedge ticket this cycle, a sustained mark higher through that zone is the signal to reduce or exit rather than to invent a new line.

portfolio_construction.adverse_scenario: Brent near 104 plus a hawkish Canadian inflation or growth surprise forces hike re-pricing, driving the March implied higher against the receive while USDCAD at 1.4143 fails to offset. Same-side crowding means that path can gap; the offsetting bull short is another desk, not this book's hedge.
portfolio_construction.chosen_actions_rationale: Keep the existing receive. Shocked risk of 4.5 million is a grind-sized expression, the mark is only 1.5 basis points through the 3.13 entry at 3.145, and the fourteen-seat handoff has no expanding tickets, so there is no markable Canada, Australia, Europe or Japan complement to attach. Reducing would be discretionary de-risking against oil and crowding, not an improvement versus the adverse path at this size.
portfolio_construction.existing_book_summary: Single line: long March 2027 CORRA 450 million, entry 3.13, frozen mark 3.145, one and a half basis points through entry. Shocked risk is 4.5 million. Last action was a hold, with no write-ups due.

pragmatist.thesis: March 2027 CORRA still prices a large tightening path versus cash at 2.30, so a modest receive remains a clean single if the Bank of Canada does not deliver the full hike stack. The line is only 1.5 basis points through the 3.13 entry, shocked risk is small, and with no expanding tickets in the handoff there is no cleaner markable complement in Canada, Australia, Europe, or Japan.

alerts: Brent at 104.32 is the primary macro risk to the Canadian receive; watch for a sustained March implied backup rather than adding a second ticket.
Receive is crowded with carry and the dove; the bull is the offsetting short. Do not add into that stack.
swinger.invalidation: The receive is wrong if the March 2027 implied sustains a move through 3.35 as oil-driven growth and inflation put the Bank of Canada onto a delivered hike path, or if cash CORRA itself backs up toward 2.75 without the contract richening. Collapse of the cash-to-implied cushion toward 40 basis points via cash rising rather than the contract falling also kills the carry-and-reprice case and requires a reduce or close, not a second ticket.
swinger.thesis: Keep the concentrated receive in March 2027 CORRA. Cash at 2.30 still leaves about 85 basis points of hikes inside 3.145, so the book is paid to sit in a Canadian path that does not fully deliver that tightening. The contract at 3.145 is only a basis point and a half through the 3.13 entry, which is noise rather than a completed thesis. Brent at 104.32 is the live threat to a Canadian reprice, but it does not justify cutting a concentrated receive or opening a second ticket because paper P&L lags a leader.
